# Welcome {.unnumbered}

This is an open, interactive textbook on **atomic layer processing**: atomic layer deposition (ALD) atomic layer etching (ALE), molecular layer deposition (MLD), and area selective deposition (ASD). It is written for graduate students and researchers who already have a background in surface chemistry and want a working understanding of these processes.

## What this book offers {.unnumbered}

- **Simulations.** Grey boxes contain small models that run in your browser. Move the sliders to see how the outputs change. Every simulation lists its assumptions underneath. Read them to help understand where a model fails as well as what it predicts.
- **Self-checks.** Blue boxes are ungraded questions to test your knowledge. The submitted answers are not kept, so feel free to make mistakes.
- **References.** Citations link to the bibliography. I am preferring the primary literature ver reviews wherever possible. Please let me know if there is something incorrect here: this is an important resource for the textbook.

## Status {.unnumbered}

This book is in early development and should be considered a draft. Corrections and suggestions are welcome. Please contact me (sean_barry@carleton.ca) if you have any comments or corrections.
